speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms; tell me, does the rash appear on the backs of your hands or primarily on the palms themselves?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: The rash has spread to your upper body and face, and you have a background working on a rice farm and with livestock. Given this exposure and the specific symptoms, have you noticed any skin thickening, tightening of your fingers, or difficulty releasing your grip?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Paracoccidioidomycosis (South American Blastomycosis). The combination of a pruritic rash on the face and upper body, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, hypopigmented macules, and occupational exposure to soil/livestock strongly supports this fungal infection.
